title: B2B Telemarketer - Home based
description:
Are you an experienced B2 B telemarketer who enjoys starting conversations, building relationships, and identifying new business opportunities?

Join Immersionn and help organisations discover how virtual reality and immersive technology could solve their business challenges. You'll learn about the innovative technology, receive ongoing training and coaching on new tech, and work with a management team that welcomes feedback and new ideas.

What's on offer
- £15 per hour.
- An uncapped £200 bonus for every client contract signed that originates from your activity, with no minimum contract value.
- Bonuses paid when the contract is signed, including where your prospect converts later.
- Home-based working with flexible hours, subject to agreed calling times and tangible results.
- Product demonstrations, onboarding, and ongoing training.
- Support and coaching from the Business Development Manager.
- Company-provided contact lists and a recommended calling script.
- The opportunity to suggest and implement new ideas.
- Potential for increased hours, greater responsibility, and higher pay as targets are achieved.

About Immersionn

Immersionn is a technology company specialising in virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), spatial computing, and immersive tech solutions that help organisations train smarter, collaborate more effectively, and bring complex projects to life.

The business is now looking to accelerate its commercial growth and is seeking an experienced B2 B Telemarketer to generate qualified new business opportunities.

The role

Your primary responsibility will be to contact prospective customers, identify genuine interest, and book an initial meeting between Immersionn's Business Development Manager and the new potential client.

You'll make outbound calls to cold and warm prospects using contact lists provided by the company, as well as following up on marketing campaigns and lead-generation initiatives.

Depending on the market being targeted, you could speak with senior decision-makers in Learning & Development, Health & Safety, Operations, Innovation, Construction, Architecture, HR, Technology, Marketing, and senior management.

This is a consultative role. The aim is to start intelligent conversations, understand an organisation's challenges, and identify where immersive technology could help. The calls will also serve as market research for Immersionn, with recommendation on changes of approach welcomed.

You do not need to be a technical expert in VR or AR. Initial onboarding will include product demonstrations, with ongoing training and support to help you explain the solutions confidently.

Once you have booked the initial meeting, Immersionn's team will take over the demonstrations and sales process. You'll receive feedback on your leads and know whether they progress into business.

Key responsibilities
- Make outbound calls to prospective customers using company-provided contact lists.
- Reach senior decision-makers within medium and large organisations.
- Build rapport and create interest with people who may not have heard of Immersionn.
- Ask questions to understand their challenges, priorities, and current approach.
- Explain Immersionn's proposition clearly, without unnecessary technical jargon.
- Identify and qualify potential opportunities.
- Book initial meetings with the Business Development Manager.
- Identify patterns in the market and suggest changes to the approach.
- Maintain accurate records in the Allo online VoIP calling system.
- Achieve agreed calling, meeting and lead-generation targets.

Target: generate at least one to two qualified leads per week.

About you:
- Exceptional telephone and communication skills.
- Significant B2 B cold-calling experience and a proven track record of generating qualified opportunities.
- Experience speaking with senior decision-makers.
- The confidence to approach businesses that have had no previous contact with Immersionn.
- The ability to explain a complex proposition in straightforward commercial language.
- A curious, consultative approach, with strong listening and questioning skills.
- Persistence, resilience and a clear understanding of what makes a genuinely qualified opportunity.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to manage your time effectively from home.
- Initiative, resourcefulness and an interest in learning about emerging technologies.
- Basic experience in any of the following would be an advantage: technology, SaaS, immersive technology, training, construction, architecture, engineering, manufacturing or professional B2 B services.

Location, hours and equipment

This is a home-based role with flexible working hours, subject to agreeing appropriate calling times and achieving the required results.

Immersionn provides access to HubSpot and the Allo online VoIP calling system. You will need your own laptop, as one is not provided.

Interested? Apply with your CV, highlighting your B2 B cold-calling and lead-generation experience.
